params.name: front_dir_path
params.help: The path to the directory containing the card fronts.

params.name: back_dir_path
params.help: The path to the directory containing one or more card backs.

params.name: double_sided_dir_path
params.help: The path to the directory containing card backs for double-sided cards.

params.name: output_path
params.help: The desired path to the output PDF.

params.name: output_images
params.help: Create images instead of a PDF.

params.name: card_size
params.help: The desired card size.

params.name: paper_size
params.help: The desired paper size.

params.name: registration
params.help: The desired registration pattern.

params.name: registration_orientation
params.help: Override the registration mark orientation without changing the card layout.

params.name: specialty
params.help: Use a specialty layout. Overrides card_size, paper_size, and registration settings.

params.name: only_fronts
params.help: Only generate front pages.

params.name: fit
params.help: How to fit front and double-sided images to card size. 'stretch' allows distortion, 'crop' preserves aspect ratio by center-cropping.

params.name: fit_backs
params.help: How to fit back images to card size. 'stretch' allows distortion, 'crop' preserves aspect ratio by center-cropping.

params.name: crop
params.help: Crop card edges of front and double-sided images (removes edges). Examples: 3mm, 0.125in, 6.5.

params.name: crop_backs
params.help: Crop card edges of back images (removes edges). Examples: 3mm, 0.125in, 6.5.

params.name: extend_edges
params.help: Crop card edges and extend them for front and double-sided images. Examples: 3mm, 0.125in.

params.name: extend_edges_backs
params.help: Crop card edges and extend them for back images only. Examples: 3mm, 0.125in.

params.name: extend_corners
params.help: Extend rounded corner regions to reduce corner artifacts for front and double-sided images. Examples: 3mm, 0.125in.

params.name: extend_corners_backs
params.help: Extend rounded corner regions to reduce corner artifacts for back images only. Examples: 3mm, 0.125in.

params.name: extend_bleed
params.help: Extend the outer bleed of outer cards on front pages (odd-numbered pages). Examples: 3mm, 0.125in.

params.name: extend_bleed_backs
params.help: Extend the outer bleed of outer cards on back pages (even-numbered pages). Examples: 3mm, 0.125in.

params.name: ppi
params.help: Pixels per inch (PPI) when creating PDF.

params.name: quality
params.help: File compression quality.

params.name: load_offset
params.help: Apply saved offsets. See `offset_pdf.py` for more information.

params.name: skip
params.help: Skip a card based on its index. Useful for registration issues. Examples: 0, 4.

params.name: label
params.help: Apply a custom label to each page.

params.name: show_outline
params.help: Show a white outline for cutting paths.

params.name: borderless
params.help: Use tighter inset to fit more cards per page.

params.name: version
params.help: Show the version and exit.

params.name: pdf_path
params.help: Path of the input PDF.

params.name: output_pdf_path
params.help: Desired path of the offset PDF.

params.name: x_offset
params.help: X-axis offset, relative to back page orientation (positive = right, negative = left).

params.name: y_offset
params.help: Y-axis offset, relative to back page orientation (positive = up, negative = down).

params.name: angle
params.help: Angle offset in degrees (positive = clockwise).

params.name: save
params.help: Save offset values.

params.name: ppi
params.help: Pixels per inch (PPI) when generating offset PDF.

params.name: source
params.help: The desired image source.

params.name: scenario_mode
params.help: Encounter card counts to use when fetching scenarios.

params.name: ignore_set_and_collector_number
params.help: Ignore provided sets and collector numbers when fetching cards.

params.name: prefer_older_sets
params.help: Prefer fetching cards from older sets if sets are not provided.

params.name: prefer_set
params.help: Prefer fetching cards from a particular set(s) if sets are not provided. Use this option multiple times to specify multiple preferred sets.

params.name: ignore_set
params.help: Exclude a set from consideration when fetching cards. Use this option multiple times to exclude multiple sets.

params.name: prefer_showcase
params.help: Prefer fetching cards with showcase treatment

params.name: prefer_extra_art
params.help: Prefer fetching cards with full art, borderless, or extended art.

params.name: prefer_lang
params.help: Preferred language for card images (printed code). Use multiple times for a priority list. Falls back to English if none are available.

params.name: prefer_ub
params.help: Prefer Universe Beyond printings when available.

params.name: ignore_ub
params.help: Exclude Universe Beyond printings from consideration.

params.name: tokens
params.help: Fetch related tokens when fetching cards

params.name: source
params.help: The desired image source.
